title: Leverage regulation, innovation, and systematic risk
title_zh: 杠杆监管、创新与系统性风险
title_primary: 杠杆监管、创新与系统性风险
title_secondary: Leverage regulation, innovation, and systematic risk
authors: Hangyu Lin, Danchen Qi, Jinhai Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how leverage regulation affects firms’ innovation incentives and systematic risk exposure. Exploiting China’s 2018 leverage regulation reform that introduced industry-specific leverage thresholds for state-owned enterprises, we employ a regression discontinuity design to identify causal effects. We find that stronger leverage regulation significantly reduces firms’ patenting activities, particularly invention patents, without evidence of changes in patent quality. Additional analyses suggest that this decline reflects a contraction in internal innovation activities rather than substitution towards external technology acquisition. Importantly, we show that leverage regulation increases firms’ systematic risk, consistent with the view that reduced innovation weakens growth opportunities and changes the composition of firm value. In contrast, we find limited short-run effects on operating performance and valuation, consistent with the long-horizon nature of innovation outcomes. Overall, our findings highlight how leverage regulation can influence firms’ innovation incentives and risk exposure through a regulatory discipline channel.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了杠杆监管如何影响企业的创新激励与系统性风险暴露。利用中国2018年针对国有企业实施的行业特定杠杆阈值改革，我们采用断点回归设计来识别因果效应。研究发现，更强的杠杆监管显著减少了企业的专利申请活动，尤其是发明专利，但未发现专利质量变化的证据。进一步分析表明，这一下降反映了内部创新活动的收缩，而非转向外部技术获取。重要的是，我们证明杠杆监管增加了企业的系统性风险，这与创新减少削弱增长机会并改变企业价值构成的看法一致。相比之下，我们发现对经营绩效和估值的短期影响有限，这与创新成果的长期性质相符。总体而言，我们的研究结果突显了杠杆监管如何通过监管约束渠道影响企业的创新激励与风险暴露。

title: Environmental foundations of human capital: Deforestation’s impact on early childhood health
title_zh: 人力资本的环境基础：森林砍伐对儿童早期健康的影响
title_primary: 人力资本的环境基础：森林砍伐对儿童早期健康的影响
title_secondary: Environmental foundations of human capital: Deforestation’s impact on early childhood health
authors: Richard Damania, Luis Diego Herrera Garcia, Hyungju Henry Kim, Leonardo Viotti, Esha Zaveri 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The environment underpins human well-being, yet its degradation increasingly threatens recent development gains, particularly in human health. This paper examines how forest loss affects early childhood health through the hydrological services that forests provide—an important but understudied mechanism. By linking high-resolution forest cover loss data with health outcomes for 0.7 million children across 46 countries, we exploit spatial and temporal variation in upstream forest cover loss measured at different points in time to assess downstream health impacts on rural households. Our findings show that upstream forest loss significantly increases the incidence of diarrheal disease among children under five, underscoring the critical role forests play in maintaining water quality through natural filtration. The health effects are not only immediate but also persistent: upstream forest cover loss leads to higher stunting rates, a key indicator of long-term productivity and human health. Furthermore, we find that the type of land cover transitions matters. Forest degradation and conversion to grassland are particularly harmful, while conversion to urban land may mitigate health impacts—likely due to improved infrastructure and access to services. These findings highlight the essential role of upstream forest ecosystems in supporting human capital and emphasize the need to preserve and restore natural capital to improve long-term health and development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 环境支撑着人类福祉，然而其退化日益威胁着近期的发展成果，尤其是在人类健康方面。本文通过森林提供的水文服务这一重要但研究不足的机制，探讨森林丧失如何影响幼儿健康。通过将高分辨率森林覆盖丧失数据与46个国家70万名儿童的健康结果相结合，我们利用不同时间点测量的上游森林覆盖丧失在空间和时间上的变化，评估其对农村家庭下游健康的影响。研究发现，上游森林丧失显著增加了五岁以下儿童腹泻病的发生率，凸显了森林通过自然过滤在维持水质方面所发挥的关键作用。健康影响不仅即时存在，而且具有持续性：上游森林覆盖丧失导致发育迟缓率上升，这是长期生产力与人类健康的关键指标。此外，我们发现土地覆盖转变的类型至关重要。森林退化和转为草地尤为有害，而转为城市用地可能减轻健康影响——这很可能归因于基础设施的改善和服务的可及性。这些发现凸显了上游森林生态系统在支撑人力资本方面的关键作用，并强调了保护和恢复自然资本以改善长期健康与发展成果的必要性。

title: Long-Term Projections of the World Economy
title_zh: 世界经济长期预测
title_primary: 世界经济长期预测
title_secondary: Long-Term Projections of the World Economy
authors: Weifeng Larry Liu, Warwick Mckibbin, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn
official: 官方在线 2025-05-25 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper surveys long-term projections of global GDP per capita and presents our own projections through 2050 using a multi-country-multi-sector general equilibrium model (G-Cubed). Existing studies generally agree that global GDP per capita growth will continue to slow in the coming decades, driven by several global challenges such as rapid population ageing, slower technological progress, weaker capital investment, and stagnating educational attainment. Projections tend to be consistent for advanced economies, but vary considerably for developing regions, highlighting the importance of alternative methodologies and assumptions, as well as inherent long-term uncertainty. While existing studies rely on neoclassical models with an aggregate production sector, the G-Cubed model takes a disaggregated approach to projecting productivity and output that accounts for dynamic interactions between sectors and across economies. Our projections incorporate the impacts of three fundamental factors: productivity growth, population ageing, and climate change. Productivity growth in advanced economies is expected to slow, but artificial intelligence could counteract the decline and serve as an engine for sustained growth. Population ageing in most advanced economies will continue to constrain labour supply, potentially reducing GDP per capita through changes in age structure. Climate change poses challenges to economic growth through multiple channels, with moderate quantitative impacts by mid-century. The extent to which developing regions can boost productivity, leverage demographic advantages, and navigate climate change will depend on policy choices, as well as governance and institutional improvements. Finally, the paper discusses the implications of geopolitical fragmentation, government debt, and public infrastructure on economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了全球人均GDP的长期预测，并利用多国多部门一般均衡模型（G-Cubed）提出了我们至2050年的预测。现有研究普遍认为，受人口快速老龄化、技术进步放缓、资本投资减弱及教育水平停滞不前等全球性挑战的影响，未来几十年全球人均GDP增长将持续放缓。各预测在发达经济体方面趋于一致，但在发展中地区差异显著，凸显了不同方法论与假设的重要性，以及固有的长期不确定性。现有研究多依赖具有总体生产部门的新古典模型，而G-Cubed模型则采用分部门方法预测生产率与产出，考虑了部门间及跨经济体的动态交互作用。我们的预测纳入了三大基本因素的影响：生产率增长、人口老龄化及气候变化。发达经济体的生产率增长预计将放缓，但人工智能可能抵消这一下降趋势，并成为持续增长的引擎。多数发达经济体的人口老龄化将继续制约劳动力供给，可能通过年龄结构变化降低人均GDP。气候变化通过多种渠道对经济增长构成挑战，至本世纪中叶其量化影响适中。发展中地区能否提升生产率、利用人口优势并应对气候变化，将取决于政策选择及治理和制度的改进。最后，本文探讨了地缘政治分裂、政府债务和公共基础设施对经济增长的影响。

title: The Dynamics of Gender Norms and Fertility Decline
title_zh: 性别规范动态与生育率下降
title_primary: 性别规范动态与生育率下降
title_secondary: The Dynamics of Gender Norms and Fertility Decline
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper models fertility as the outcome of gender‐biased technological progress interacting with endogenous social norms governing childcare. When rising female wages outpace norm adjustment, the inherited norm makes reallocating childcare toward fathers costly, so mothers bear a disproportionate burden and the shadow price of children rises. In cross‐country data, fertility falls faster where women's relative standing rises, especially where norms are tighter or more rigid. Calibrated to South Korea (1976–2016), the model shows that strong, slow‐adjusting norms deepen the decline. Despite smaller short‐run effects, male childcare subsidies yield larger long‐run gains than female subsidies by accelerating convergence to egalitarian norms.
abstract_zh: 本文将生育率建模为性别偏见技术进步与内生社会规范（管理育儿责任）相互作用的结果。当女性工资增长超过规范调整速度时，继承的规范使得将育儿责任重新分配给父亲变得代价高昂，因此母亲承担不成比例的负担，孩子的影子价格上升。跨国数据显示，在女性相对地位提升较快的地方，生育率下降更快，尤其是在规范更严格或更僵化的地区。以韩国（1976-2016年）为校准对象，模型表明，强大且调整缓慢的规范加深了生育率下降。尽管短期效应较小，但男性育儿补贴通过加速向平等规范的收敛，比女性补贴带来更大的长期收益。

title: AI’s gains are large and rising, but unevenly shared
title_zh: 人工智能收益巨大且持续增长，但分配不均
title_primary: 人工智能收益巨大且持续增长，但分配不均
title_secondary: AI’s gains are large and rising, but unevenly shared
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How large is the labour cost saved by AI, and how is it distributed across occupations? Using five waves of the Anthropic Economic Index from January 2025 to February 2026, this column constructs two novel measures from observed AI usage across countries over the world. The labour cost equivalent values the time currently saved by AI at $2.7 trillion annually (3.4% of GDP), concentrated in a small professional enclave in developing economies, with concentration declining in many countries.
abstract_zh: 人工智能节省的劳动力成本规模有多大，其在不同职业间的分布如何？利用2025年1月至2026年2月间五轮Anthropic经济指数数据，本文基于全球各国观察到的AI使用情况，构建了两个新颖的衡量指标。劳动力成本等值将当前AI节省的时间估值每年达2.7万亿美元（占GDP的3.4%），集中于发展中经济体的一个小型专业领域，且在许多国家中，这种集中度正在下降。

title: Intergenerational Cultural Transmission with Social Interactions as An Evolutionary Game
title_zh: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈分析
title_primary: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈分析
title_secondary: Intergenerational Cultural Transmission with Social Interactions as An Evolutionary Game
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies a multi-trait cultural transmission model with social interactions. The resulting cultural dynamic is equivalent to an evolutionary dynamic on a population game that combines social payoffs and cultural biases. This transformation allows us to apply tools from evolutionary game theory to examine cultural homogeneity and heterogeneity. We show that when social interactions have a coordination nature, cultural biases can push the cultural dynamic toward selecting a culturally homogeneous equilibrium that is efficient for those interactions. In contrast, when interactions have an anti-coordination nature, cultural biases usually drive the dynamic toward a culturally heterogeneous state that differs from the efficient equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含社会互动的多特征文化传播模型。由此产生的文化动态等价于一个结合了社会收益与文化偏好的种群博弈上的演化动态。这一转换使我们能够运用演化博弈论的工具来考察文化的同质性与异质性。我们表明，当社会互动具有协调性质时，文化偏好能推动文化动态趋向于选择对这些互动而言高效的文化同质均衡。相反，当互动具有反协调性质时，文化偏好通常驱使动态走向一个不同于高效均衡的文化异质状态。

title: Let the tree decide: FABART. A non-parametric factor model for nonlinear oil shock transmission
title_zh: 让树来决定：FABART——非线性石油冲击传导的非参数因子模型
title_primary: 让树来决定：FABART——非线性石油冲击传导的非参数因子模型
title_secondary: Let the tree decide: FABART. A non-parametric factor model for nonlinear oil shock transmission
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The question of how oil supply news shocks transmit to real activity, financial conditions, and regional labor markets is back at the center of the macroeconomic research agenda. To answer this question, we introduce the Factor Bayesian Additive Regression Tree (FABART) model, a nonlinear factor-augmented vector autoregression model, and apply it to a large U.S. macro-financial dataset with externally identified oil supply news shocks. The framework combines a large macro-financial information set with a flexible nonparametric measurement equation, allowing nonlinear transmission to emerge from the data rather than being imposed through a pre-specified functional form. We find that adverse oil supply news shocks generate stronger and more persistent contractions in real activity than the expansions associated with favorable shocks of comparable magnitude, with especially pronounced differences in industrial production, financial variables, and equity prices. Employment responses are highly heterogeneous across U.S. states, with substantially stronger contractions in manufacturing-intensive regions, while energy-producing states display partially offsetting dynamics following adverse oil supply news shocks. Across shock magnitudes, nonlinearities arise mainly between very small and moderate oil-price movements: small shocks generate weak and imprecisely estimated responses, while moderate shocks already produce economically meaningful effects on industrial production and regional employment. Larger shocks do not systematically generateproportionally stronger responses across variables and shock signs. JEL Classification: C11, C32, E32, Q43
abstract_zh: 石油供给新闻冲击如何传导至实际经济活动、金融状况和区域劳动力市场这一问题，重新成为宏观经济研究议程的核心议题。为回答这一问题，我们引入了因子贝叶斯加法回归树（FABART）模型——一种非线性因子增强向量自回归模型，并将其应用于包含外部识别的石油供给新闻冲击的大型美国宏观金融数据集。该框架将大型宏观金融信息集与灵活的非参数测量方程相结合，使非线性传导能够从数据中自然涌现，而非通过预设的函数形式加以施加。我们发现，不利的石油供给新闻冲击所产生的实际经济活动收缩，比同等规模有利冲击所伴随的扩张更为强烈且更具持续性，其中工业生产、金融变量和股票价格方面的差异尤为显著。就业响应在美国各州之间呈现高度异质性，制造业密集型地区的收缩幅度明显更大，而能源生产州在面临不利石油供给新闻冲击时则表现出部分抵消性动态。就冲击规模而言，非线性主要出现在极小与中等油价变动之间：小冲击产生的响应较弱且估计精度不高，而中等冲击已能对工业生产和区域就业产生具有经济意义的影响。更大规模的冲击并不会在变量和冲击方向上系统性地产生成比例更强的响应。JEL分类：C11, C32, E32, Q43

title: Nonlinearities in the Oil Price-Output Relationship
title_zh: 石油价格与产出关系中的非线性特征
title_primary: 石油价格与产出关系中的非线性特征
title_secondary: Nonlinearities in the Oil Price-Output Relationship
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: It is customary to suggest that the asymmetry in the transmission of oil price shocks to real output is well established. Much of the empirical work cited as being in support of asymmetries, however, has not directly tested the hypothesis of an asymmetric transmission of oil price innovations. Moreover, many of the papers quantifying these asymmetric responses are based on censored oil price VAR models which recently have been shown to be invalid. Other studies are based on dynamic correlations in the data that do not shed light on the central question of whether the structural responses of real output triggered by positive and negative oil price innovations are asymmetric. Recently, a number of new methodologies have been introduced and applied to the problem of testing and quantifying asymmetric responses of U.S. real economic activity to positive and negative oil price innovations. Our objective is to put this literature in perspective, to contrast it with more traditional approaches, to highlight directions for further research, and to reconcile some seemingly conflicting results reported in the literature.
abstract_zh: 通常认为，石油价格冲击对实际产出影响的非对称传导已得到充分证实。然而，多数被引证支持非对称性的实证研究并未直接检验石油价格创新非对称传导的假设。此外，许多量化这些非对称响应的论文基于经审查的石油价格VAR模型，而近期研究表明此类模型存在缺陷。另一些研究则依赖数据中的动态相关性，未能阐明核心问题——正向与负向石油价格创新所引发的实际产出结构性响应是否具有非对称性。近年来，一系列新方法被引入并应用于检验与量化美国实际经济活动对正负石油价格创新的非对称响应。本文旨在系统梳理该领域文献，对比传统研究路径，指明未来研究方向，并调和文献中看似矛盾的若干结论。

abstract: 技术标准国际对接是我国主动融入全球创新网络，实现以开放促创新的高水平制度型开放举措。本文通过自然语言处理方法测度专利文本与采标技术标准文本相似度，识别企业受技术标准国际对接的影响程度，结合高维固定效应模型实证检验技术标准国际对接对企业国际创新合作的影响。研究发现，技术标准国际对接通过降低跨国技术协调成本、契约风险成本以及贸易摩擦引致的不确定性冲击，显著提升企业国际创新合作水平。但技术标准国际对接并未有效反哺国内创新，原因在于当前我国融入全球创新网络过程中技术标准对接模式的不匹配。以国际合作专利成果署名顺序为切入点的研究发现，完全等同、等效采用国际标准虽能更有效提高我国企业国际合作创新水平，但对其创新主导能力的提升有限；而采用与中国技术发展阶段更匹配的修改后采标方式进行标准对接，能有效提升国内企业国际创新合作主导能力，提高企业创新质量、突破企业自身创新边界、扩大企业创新国际影响力。基于企业创新相对基础差异的深入分析发现，创新基础较弱的企业盲目追求标准一致性是导致技术标准国际对接难以反哺国内创新的关键。本研究从标准制度型开放视角，为我国充分利用全球创新资源、实现科技创新自立自强提供了现实方案和经验证据。

abstract_zh: 我们针对欧盟十国的私营部门男性群体研究了这些问题。研究结果表明，在绝大多数国家中，培训投资在条件工资分布各分位点上产生了相似的百分比回报。仅比利时在此方面属于例外情况。然而，我们的结果确实表明，各国培训的平均回报率存在显著差异。

title: Formalized employee search and labor demand
title_zh: 正式化的员工搜寻与劳动力需求
title_primary: 正式化的员工搜寻与劳动力需求
title_secondary: Formalized employee search and labor demand
authors: Lukas Hensel, Tsegay Tekleselassie, Marc Witte
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firms in low- and middle-income countries rarely advertise their vacancies formally and instead use social networks to find employees. We experimentally reduce the cost of formal employee search for small and medium-sized enterprises in Ethiopia to test whether informal search constrains the number and type of positions firms create. We find that treated firms increase formal search and shift their labor demand towards more demanding white-collar positions. However, they struggle to fill these newly created vacancies. We provide suggestive evidence that expectations contribute to this result, especially when firms lack prior experience with formal hiring channels: firms appear overly optimistic about the applicant pools formal search will generate, and job-seekers’ wage expectations exceed firms’ wages.
abstract_zh: 中低收入国家的企业很少正式发布招聘广告，而是利用社交网络寻找员工。我们通过实验降低埃塞俄比亚中小企业正式员工搜索的成本，以检验非正式搜索是否限制了企业创造的职位数量与类型。我们发现，受处理的企业增加了正式搜索，并将其劳动力需求转向要求更高的白领职位。然而，这些企业难以填补新设立的职位空缺。我们提供的初步证据表明，预期因素促成了这一结果，尤其是当企业缺乏正式招聘渠道的先前经验时：企业似乎对正式搜索将产生的应聘者群体过于乐观，而求职者的工资预期超过了企业的工资水平。

title: Forced Displacement and Social Capital in the Long Run: Lessons from the Indian Partition
title_zh: 长期被迫流离失所与社会资本：印度分治的教训
title_primary: 长期被迫流离失所与社会资本：印度分治的教训
title_secondary: Forced Displacement and Social Capital in the Long Run: Lessons from the Indian Partition
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of migrant inflows due to forced displacement events on the social capital in the recipient societies. We exploit the setting of Partition of India. Using data from districts in post 1947 India belonging to six states that saw a higher inflow of migrants, relative to outflow, we analyse how the â€˜shock' inflow of migrants affected social capital in the districts sixty years later. The shock is measured as the proportion of "displacedâ€ migrants in Indian districts in 1951 from census data. Survey data conducted in 2007 indicates that social capital is lower in districts that received more Partition migrants. The effect remains strongly robust to spatial robustness checks, contemporary differences in a host of demographic and public goods provision indicators. We find that these effects are mediated through riots, community conflicts and violent crime that start from Partition sixty years ago and continue through to more recent times. We also find that political participation, a proxy for social capital, falls over time in districts which see a relatively larger flow of displaced migrants. Our study contributes to the understanding of the long run implications of large forced displacement events.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了因被迫迁移事件导致的移民流入对接收地社会资本的影响。我们以印度分治为背景，利用1947年后印度六个移民净流入较高地区的县级数据，分析了六十年前移民的“冲击性”流入如何影响这些地区的社会资本。基于1951年人口普查数据，我们将冲击量化为印度各县“流离失所”移民的比例。2007年的调查数据显示，接收更多分治移民的县社会资本水平较低。这一效应在空间稳健性检验以及当代人口与公共品供给指标差异的控制下依然显著。研究发现，这些影响通过分治时期开始并延续至今的骚乱、社区冲突和暴力犯罪等中介机制发挥作用。此外，在流离失所移民流入相对较多的县，政治参与度（社会资本的代理变量）随时间推移而下降。本研究有助于理解大规模被迫迁移事件的长期影响。

title: The integrated food security phase classification system: seven defining characteristics
title_zh: 综合粮食安全阶段分类系统：七个定义性特征
title_primary: 综合粮食安全阶段分类系统：七个定义性特征
title_secondary: The integrated food security phase classification system: seven defining characteristics
authors: Hope Michelson, Erin Lentz, John Armstrong, Kaija Korpi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Integrated Phase Classification (IPC) is the global standard for analyzing and classifying food insecurity, including famine. While media attention tends to focus on IPC famine analyses, the IPC conducts most of its analyses in non-famine contexts, providing critical assessments of sub-national food insecurity. These analyses guide considerable humanitarian intervention and investment. We argue that IPC analyses are most valuable and effective when users understand the processes, data, and methodological safeguards that underlie and inform IPC findings. We present and discuss seven essential characteristics to clarify IPC operations and interpretation including its analysis framework, consensus-based processes, reporting output interpretation, and famine classification protocols. These seven characteristics are key to the IPC’s capacity to monitor dynamic, overlapping and chronic circumstances of food insecurity. We discuss the strengths and limitations of these characteristics, and we work through implications for interpreting and applying IPC outputs. While our primary objective is to clarify IPC processes, we conclude with a section that is more normative, discussing the IPC’s role and significance in the current global humanitarian system. At a time of significant strain on the humanitarian system and in the face of a loss of practitioner expertise at all levels, a more complete understanding of the IPC’s processes will enhance its utility in an increasingly constrained humanitarian landscape.
abstract_zh: 综合阶段分类（IPC）是全球分析粮食不安全（包括饥荒）的标准。尽管媒体关注往往聚焦于IPC饥荒分析，但IPC在非饥荒情境下进行了大部分分析，提供了对次国家级粮食不安全状况的关键评估。这些分析指导了大量人道主义干预和投资。我们认为，当用户理解支撑并告知IPC发现的过程、数据和方法论保障时，IPC分析最具价值和有效性。我们提出并讨论了七个关键特征，以阐明IPC的操作和解读，包括其分析框架、基于共识的过程、报告输出的解读以及饥荒分类协议。这七个特征对于IPC监测动态、重叠及慢性粮食不安全状况的能力至关重要。我们讨论了这些特征的优势与局限，并探讨了其对解读和应用IPC输出的启示。虽然我们的主要目标是澄清IPC过程，但我们在结尾部分转向更具规范性的讨论，探讨IPC在当前全球人道主义体系中的角色和意义。在人道主义体系面临重大压力、各级从业者专业知识流失之际，更全面地理解IPC过程将增强其在日益受限的人道主义环境中的实用性。

title: The effect of new‐product introduction on nutrition consumption: The case of Greek yogurt
title_zh: 新产品引入对营养消费的影响：以希腊酸奶为例
title_primary: 新产品引入对营养消费的影响：以希腊酸奶为例
title_secondary: The effect of new‐product introduction on nutrition consumption: The case of Greek yogurt
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract True dietary change typically occurs through consumer preferences, and when changes in product attributes reflect these preferences, category‐level demand can be substantially rearranged. In this study, we show that a successful new product may fundamentally change the nature of an entire category, and change consumers' nutrient consumption by altering the nutrient content of the food products they consume. Greek yogurt, for example, offers a very different combination of nutrients relative to other types of yogurts. The fact that it was immediately successful after its introduction provides an example of a transformational new product—one that potentially changed the nutrient‐consumption profiles of yogurt buyers. We use a quasi‐experimental approach with propensity score matching (DiD + PSM) to identify the effect of introducing Greek yogurt on yogurt buyers’ nutrient consumption. We find that the introduction of Greek yogurt led to yogurt purchases with greater overall protein and calorie content, but lower fat and carbohydrate content. We use the case of Greek yogurt to show that a relatively simple innovative common consumer product can have far‐reaching implications for the nature of nutrients consumed from that category. Our findings point to the importance of information policies, and their interaction with consumer preferences, on changing dietary outcomes.
abstract_zh: 真正的饮食变化通常源于消费者偏好的转变，当产品属性的变化反映出这些偏好时，类别层面的需求可能会发生显著重组。本研究表明，一款成功的新产品可能从根本上改变整个类别的性质，并通过改变消费者所消费食品的营养成分来影响其营养摄入。例如，希腊酸奶相较于其他类型的酸奶，提供了截然不同的营养组合。其上市后迅速取得成功，成为变革性新产品的典范——这类产品可能改变了酸奶购买者的营养摄入结构。我们采用准实验方法，结合倾向得分匹配（双重差分法+倾向得分匹配法，DiD+PSM），以识别希腊酸奶引入对酸奶购买者营养摄入的影响。研究发现，希腊酸奶的引入导致酸奶购买中总蛋白质和热量含量增加，而脂肪和碳水化合物含量降低。我们以希腊酸奶为例，说明一个相对简单的创新性大众消费品可能对该类别中摄入的营养成分性质产生深远影响。我们的研究结果强调了信息政策及其与消费者偏好相互作用在改变饮食结果方面的重要性。

title: Targeting State Aid: Firm-level Evidence from France
title_zh: 定向国家援助：来自法国的企业层面证据
title_primary: 定向国家援助：来自法国的企业层面证据
title_secondary: Targeting State Aid: Firm-level Evidence from France
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the firm-level impact of state aid in France from 2016–23 and how targeting affects economic outcomes. Using firm-level data and a difference-in-differences approach, we find that aid is most effective for young firms, improving real outcomes while also crowding in private debt financing. Size-based targeting, by contrast, has limited impact. R&D support is particularly effective for young firms in high-tech sectors, and energy aid has the strongest effects in manufacturing, pointing to its potential role in helping firms reduce emissions and facilitating the green transition.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2016至2023年间法国国家援助对企业层面的影响，以及援助目标设定如何影响经济结果。利用企业层面数据与双重差分方法，我们发现援助对年轻企业最为有效，既能改善实际经济表现，也能带动私人债务融资。相比之下，基于规模的援助目标设定效果有限。研发支持对高科技行业的年轻企业尤为有效，而能源援助在制造业中效果最为显著，这表明其在帮助企业减少排放、推动绿色转型方面具有潜在作用。

title: Rural Migrants and Urban Informality: Evidence From Brazil
title_zh: 巴西农村移民与城市非正规性：实证证据
title_primary: 巴西农村移民与城市非正规性：实证证据
title_secondary: Rural Migrants and Urban Informality: Evidence From Brazil
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the economic effects of rural‐urban migration on Brazilian cities. Using a shift‐share IV design, we show that, over a decade, drought‐induced immigration reduces informality, has no effect on unemployment, and increases the number of formal firms and jobs. Downward formal wage adjustments play a key role, as these long‐run effects are weaker in regions with stronger wage rigidity. In the short run, when wage rigidity is strongest, we replicate the informality‐increasing effects documented in the literature. We develop and estimate a model of firm dynamics and informality that rationalizes these results. The counterfactuals reveal that, in the short run, the informal sector absorbs the expanding labor force and acts as a “stepping‐stone” to formality for firms and workers. In the long run, however, it reduces the aggregate benefits from immigration by allowing the least productive firms to survive.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了农村向城市迁移对巴西城市的经济效应。利用shift-share IV设计，我们表明，在十年间，干旱引发的移民降低了非正规性，对失业率无影响，并增加了正规企业和就业岗位的数量。下行正规工资调整在此过程中发挥关键作用，因为这些长期效应在工资刚性较强的地区较弱。在短期内，当工资刚性最强时，我们复现了文献中记载的非正规性增强效应。我们构建并估计了一个企业动态与非正规性模型，以合理解释这些结果。反事实分析揭示，在短期内，非正规部门吸收了扩张的劳动力，并作为企业和工人迈向正规化的“踏脚石”。然而，从长期来看，它通过允许效率最低的企业存活，减少了移民带来的总体收益。

title: Environmental benefits of renewable energy: Evidence from coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions
title_zh: 可再生能源的环境效益：来自煤炭开采导致森林砍伐和空气污染排放的证据
title_primary: 可再生能源的环境效益：来自煤炭开采导致森林砍伐和空气污染排放的证据
title_secondary: Environmental benefits of renewable energy: Evidence from coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The global energy transition is accelerating the phase-out of fossil fuel combustion, yet its indirect environmental benefits through reduced fossil fuel extraction remain underexplored. This paper examines whether coal mining-induced deforestation and air pollution emissions are smaller in regions with greater renewable energy deployment in China. Leveraging high-resolution geographical data on permitted coal mining areas, along with satellite data on forest cover and PM2.5 emissions in the past two decades, we find that while coal mining reduces forest cover by 3.3%, integrating an additional 1% of local renewable energy into the electricity grid is associated with about 0.3% lower deforestation. As PM2.5 is transported downwind, ambient pollution and benefits of renewables have spillover to counties within 30 km of coal mines. Monetizing these benefits of avoided deforestation and air pollution, we estimate that the total value can exceed one billion US dollars. Our findings offer policy insights to promote energy transition with ecological preservation and environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 全球能源转型正加速化石燃料燃烧的淘汰进程，然而，通过减少化石燃料开采所带来的间接环境效益仍未得到充分探讨。本文考察了中国可再生能源部署较多的地区，其煤炭开采引发的森林砍伐和空气污染排放是否相对较少。利用过去二十年中关于许可煤矿区的高分辨率地理数据，以及卫星获取的森林覆盖和PM2.5排放数据，我们发现，尽管煤炭开采使森林覆盖率减少了3.3%，但当地电网中每增加1%的可再生能源，与约0.3%的森林砍伐减少相关联。由于PM2.5随风向下风向传输，环境中的污染及可再生能源的效益会溢出至煤矿周边30公里内的县区。将这些避免的森林砍伐和空气污染所带来的效益货币化后，我们估计其总价值可超过十亿美元。我们的研究为促进能源转型与生态保护及环境保护协同推进提供了政策启示。

title: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions
title_zh: 联邦机构会计质量在联邦预算分配中的作用：来自审计意见的证据
title_primary: 联邦机构会计质量在联邦预算分配中的作用：来自审计意见的证据
title_secondary: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the role of the accounting quality of U.S. federal agencies, measured with audit opinions, in federal budget allocations to those agencies. We find that, when an agency receives a modified audit opinion, the president proposes and Congress enacts a lower budget for the agency, and the budgetary disagreement between them increases. These effects strengthen when the president and Congress have stronger incentives to demonstrate spending accountability to taxpayers. Exploiting the enactment of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Audit Requirement Target Act, which required the DHS to end its longstanding modified audit opinions, we find that following the act's implementation, the president proposed higher budgets for the DHS and the budgetary disagreement over the DHS diminished. These findings suggest that high-quality federal agency accounting influences budgetary decisions by reducing agencies' information asymmetry with politicians (the president and Congress) and taxpayers, facilitating the evaluation of agencies' spending accountability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国联邦机构会计质量（以审计意见衡量）在其联邦预算分配中的作用。研究发现，当某机构收到保留审计意见时，总统提议的预算及国会通过的预算均较低，且两者间的预算分歧增大。当总统与国会有更强动机向纳税人展示支出问责性时，上述效应更为显著。利用《国土安全部审计要求目标法案》的颁布——该法案要求国土安全部终止其长期存在的保留审计意见——我们发现，在该法案实施后，总统对国土安全部提议的预算有所提高，且围绕该部的预算分歧有所减少。这些发现表明，高质量的联邦机构会计通过降低机构与政治家（总统和国会）及纳税人之间的信息不对称，促进了对机构支出问责性的评估，从而影响预算决策。

title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据
title_primary: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据
title_secondary: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
official: 官方在线 2026-05-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。

title: Monetary policy trade-offs amid global supply chain disruptions
title_zh: 全球供应链中断中的货币政策权衡
title_primary: 全球供应链中断中的货币政策权衡
title_secondary: Monetary policy trade-offs amid global supply chain disruptions
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic led to unprecedented disruptions in global supply chains (GSC), coupled with large fiscal stimulus. This paper employs a proxy structural VAR model to examine GSC shocks, the Federal Reserve’s response, and their propagation under two counterfactual policy rules. Large fiscal stimulus amplifies inflation while cushioning the downturn from GSC shocks. Historically, the Fed has looked through price surges and adopted a loose stance. The first counterfactual, which stabilises inflation, entails less accommodation and yields a more favourable inflation-output trade-off, reflecting greater price flexibility and limited output losses. The second, which minimises a dual-mandate loss function under inflation targeting (IT) or average inflation targeting (AIT), calls for greater initial easing. Relative to IT, AIT implies a looser policy that generates more persistent inflation and ultimately requires a contractionary response, worsening the trade-off.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情导致了全球供应链（GSC）前所未有的中断，同时伴随着大规模的财政刺激。本文采用代理结构向量自回归模型，考察了全球供应链冲击、美联储的应对措施，以及在两种反事实政策规则下的传导效应。大规模的财政刺激在缓解全球供应链冲击引发的经济衰退的同时，加剧了通货膨胀。从历史角度看，美联储一直忽视价格飙升并采取宽松的政策立场。第一种反事实情景旨在稳定通胀，其政策宽松程度较低，却带来了更优的通胀-产出权衡，反映出更高的价格灵活性和有限的产出损失。第二种反事实情景在通胀目标制（IT）或平均通胀目标制（AIT）下最小化双重使命损失函数，则要求更大幅度的初始宽松。与IT相比，AIT意味着更宽松的政策，导致通胀更具持续性，并最终需要紧缩性应对，从而恶化了权衡关系。

title: Can online learning alter labor force attachment? Evidence from U.S. labor markets
title_primary: Can online learning alter labor force attachment? Evidence from U.S. labor markets
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Since the COVID-19 pandemic, online learning has surged in the U.S. This paper addresses two key questions: Who is participating in online learning, and how does enrolment in online learning impact labour market outcomes? Using data from the Current Population Survey, I construct a measure of occupational exposure to online learning and track the labour market outcomes of thousands of individuals from 2019 through 2022. I find that individuals engaged in online learning tend to be more educated, earn higher wages, and are typically employed in computer- and office-focused occupations. On average, exposure to online learning is associated with greater employment stability. Notably, women with young children are more likely to exit the labour force than those without; however, online learning is associated with a reduction in these excess exits.

title: The effects of margin change on market quality: evidence from China’s New live hog futures market
title_zh: 保证金变动对市场质量的影响：来自中国生猪期货新市场的证据
title_primary: 保证金变动对市场质量的影响：来自中国生猪期货新市场的证据
title_secondary: The effects of margin change on market quality: evidence from China’s New live hog futures market
authors: Jiaxin Zheng, Tao Xiong, Miao Li, Dongsheng Zheng
official: 官方在线 2025-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Trading regulations are the basis for ensuring the smooth operation of a commodity futures market. Theoretically, the level of the margin requirement directly affects traders’ transaction costs and decisions, which in turn affects commodity futures’ market quality. We take the two adjustments of the margin requirement in China’s new live hog futures market as quasi-natural experiments and examine the impact of the margin requirement adjustment on the market quality of the live hog futures market. Specifically, this paper uses tick-by-tick data to measure market quality and the synthetic control method to conduct causal inference. Our empirical results show that the policy effect of reducing both the margin requirement and price limit at the same time has a more significant impact on market quality than that of reducing the margin requirement alone. The improvement in market activity is particularly significant. Robustness and placebo tests further support our main conclusions, and our findings provide valuable guidance for futures exchanges and regulators in formulating futures trading policies to improve market quality.
abstract_zh: 交易规则是保障商品期货市场平稳运行的基础。理论上，保证金要求的水平直接影响交易者的交易成本和决策，进而影响商品期货的市场质量。本研究将我国新推出的活体生猪期货市场中两次保证金要求的调整视为准自然实验，考察保证金要求调整对活体生猪期货市场质量的影响。具体而言，本文采用逐笔数据衡量市场质量，并运用合成控制法进行因果推断。实证结果表明，同时降低保证金要求和涨跌停板幅度的政策效应，对市场质量的影响比单独降低保证金要求更为显著，其中市场活跃度的提升尤为突出。稳健性检验和安慰剂检验进一步支持了我们的主要结论，研究结果为期货交易所及监管机构制定旨在提升市场质量的期货交易政策提供了有价值的参考。

title: Achieve or go against one’s inclinations: the real effect of affiliated directors in vertical M&A
title_zh: 顺应还是违背意愿：关联董事在纵向并购中的真实效应
title_primary: 顺应还是违背意愿：关联董事在纵向并购中的真实效应
title_secondary: Achieve or go against one’s inclinations: the real effect of affiliated directors in vertical M&A
authors: Yali Gu Wenxuan Han a School of Finance, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Shanghai, Chinab School of Economics, Guangxi University, Nanning, China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In accordance with the principles of transaction cost theory, vertical mergers and acquisitions (M&A) represent an efficacious strategy for mitigating uncertainties and sustaining competitive advantages. However, the effectiveness of vertical mergers is influenced by various internal and external factors. Utilizing panel data regression models and financial data from China’s A-share listed companies spanning 2016 to 2021, we endeavour to elucidate this phenomenon by examining affiliated directors, an internal factor of enterprises, and explore underlying mechanisms. Our analysis reveals that through familiarity bias and integration level of industrial chain, the involvement of affiliated directors in vertical mergers mitigates the effectiveness of uncertainty reduction. This negative impact is more pronounced in firms with a relatively low number of analysts tracking, substantial financing constraints, low profitability, and limited institutional environments in their regions. Empirical results derived from robustness checks and mechanism tests indicate that stringent internal controls, robust regulatory measures, and well-formulated industrial policies are vital for realizing M&A synergies, thereby fostering the high-quality development of listed companies and protecting the interests of investors. KEYWORDS: Corporate finance vertical merger and acquisitions affiliated directors firm uncertainty JEL CLASSIFICATION: G30 G34 G32
abstract_zh: 依据交易成本理论原则，纵向并购是降低不确定性、维持竞争优势的有效策略。然而，纵向并购的有效性受到多种内外部因素的影响。本文利用2016至2021年中国A股上市公司面板数据回归模型及财务数据，通过考察企业内部因素——关联董事，试图阐明这一现象，并探究其潜在机制。分析表明，由于熟悉性偏差与产业链整合程度，关联董事参与纵向并购会削弱不确定性降低的效果。这种负面效应在分析师跟踪数量较少、融资约束较大、盈利能力较低以及所在地区制度环境有限的企业中更为显著。稳健性检验与机制检验的实证结果表明，严格的内部控制、有力的监管措施以及完善的产业政策对于实现并购协同效应至关重要，从而促进上市公司高质量发展并保护投资者利益。关键词：公司金融；纵向并购；关联董事；企业不确定性；JEL分类：G30；G34；G32

title: Farmland Rental Rates: Does Organic Certification Matter?
title_zh: 农田租赁价格：有机认证是否重要？
title_primary: 农田租赁价格：有机认证是否重要？
title_secondary: Farmland Rental Rates: Does Organic Certification Matter?
authors: Fuller, K. B., Janzen, J. P., Munkhnasan, B.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate U.S. organic farmers’ marginal willingness to pay to rent an acre of certified organic land relative to conventional farmland. Using a selection-on-observables design and farm-level data on farmland rental rates, organic status, and many conditioning variables, we address the role of profitability in mediating the effect of organic status. We find a 26% rental rate premium for organic farmland not driven by higher profits on organic farms. This premium is a modest incentive for landowners but a barrier for tenants to convert to organic farming practices, which may explain limited growth in U.S. organic acreage. abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国有机农户相对于传统农田，为租用一英亩经认证的有机土地所愿意支付的边际意愿。采用基于可观测变量的选择设计，并结合农场层面的农田租金率、有机状态及众多条件变量的数据，我们探讨了盈利能力在调节有机状态效应中的作用。我们发现，有机农田的租金率溢价为26%，这一溢价并非由有机农场更高的利润所驱动。这一溢价对土地所有者而言是适度的激励，但对租户而言则是转向有机耕作实践的障碍，这可能解释了美国有机种植面积增长有限的原因。JEL分类号：Q11 Q15。本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://er.uwpress.org。
